svg.title: Sign in with AgentBuff and entitlement
svg.desc: 1. The owner taps Sign in with AgentBuff and is sent through OpenID Connect with PKCE. 2. BYM verifies the ES256 ID token and finds the owner by the AgentBuff subject. 3. A strict entitlement check runs, then BYM sets a session cookie whose value is stored only as a hash. 4. Later requests recheck entitlement with a 10 minute cache; only a clear negative answer freezes the book. 5. A frozen book keeps all data and can still be exported; agent calls get a frozen error with a renewal link.
